viewing_check: Estimate $50-80, current bid $30. The Mannix plaque is the key piece: a similar plaque realised A$320 at Leski (est. $120-200, 2023 per Google snippet) but another sold on eBay AU for A$47.01 in Sept 2026, so values are inconsistent. Check in person that it is a heavy cast plaque with the title plate and no damage. The candlesticks sell about $30-110 a pair. The brass button stick (stamped WD broad arrow 1955) is a cleaning tool with little value. The rest is ordinary brass, a few dollars each. Prices are mixed and the Leski result is about 3 years old.
